_comment: What the race mode says in Assetto Corsa: its messages and the result card. Each key race.<name> reaches the mode
as <NAME> in capitals, dots as underscores (race.result.win is RESULT_WIN); the mode says its first line. {name}
is a placeholder the mode fills: {driver} a racer's name, {pass} and {passes} a test-and-tune's pass and their count.

lines.race.result.win: You won a few bucks, not bad!
lines.race.result.crash:
Lucky you weren't killed!
Better luck next time!
lines.race.result.false_start:
You jumped the gun!
No contest, and everybody saw it.
lines.race.result.disqualified:
You hit him in his own lane!
That's a DQ, you lose.
lines.race.result.busted:
Busted!
The cops have you and your car.
lines.race.result.red_light:
Red light! You left before your green.
No contest, and everybody saw it.
lines.race.broke_down.engine:
The engine let go!
You're out of the race.
lines.race.broke_down.gearbox:

You're out of the race.
